name: Cole
source:
Lyle's older brother. This short-tempered pediatrician runs on coffee, cigarettes, and caramel candies. Insensitive and unsociable, Cole isn't great with words, especially words from the heart. He's a workaholic who takes his role as Lyle's caretaker quite seriously. He loves his little brother and is very protective of him.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/karitsa/doki-doki-dollmaker-a-heartfelt-bl-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
